turns.question: Who spent more per order in September 2026, our Turkish or our Dutch customers, and what was their average?
turns.answer: Turkish customers spent more per order in September 2026: an average of EUR 109.64 per order against EUR 109.45 for Dutch customers (average order value over non-cancelled orders placed 1 to 30 September 2026).
